Hi Corinne,

Great news - production signed off on your revised schedule this
afternoon. To confirm where we landed:

- Your reviewed copyedits are now due 10/16/2026 (instead of 10/02).
- First-pass page proofs will reach you around 11/20/2026, with two weeks
  for corrections.
- The publication date stays March 2, 2027. Ava confirmed the catalog
  copy already went to the sales reps, so that date can't move.

On the map question: we'll keep the two hand-drawn maps and drop the
third (Caravan routes, 1420s), as you suggested. The cartographer will
send revised versions with the corrected spelling of "Taghaza" by next
Friday.

Also, accounting tells me the second advance installment ($7,500, due on
acceptance of the complete draft) was released on
09/21/2026. You should see it in your account by early next week.

Enjoy the weekend, and good luck with the review!

Best,
